    ("vota", f"{BASE}/vota/final/predictions.jsonl"),
    ("full_trace", f"{BASE}/full_trace/final/predictions.jsonl"),
])

def load_errors(path):
    errors = set()
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            d = json.loads(line)
            if d["pred"] != d["label"]:
                errors.add(d["id"])
    return errors

# Load all error sets
error_sets = {}
for name, path in CONDITIONS.items():
    error_sets[name] = load_errors(path)
    print(f"{name}: {len(error_sets[name])} errors")

# Total samples
with open(list(CONDITIONS.values())[0]) as f:
    total = sum(1 for _ in f)
print(f"\nTotal samples: {total}")

# --- Subset relationship verification ---
print("\n=== Subset Relationship Verification ===")
# Expected hierarchy: full_trace ⊆ vota ⊆ exception_only ⊆ no_trace
# (more info = fewer errors, so richer conditions should have fewer/subset errors)
pairs = [
    ("full_trace", "vota"),
    ("vota", "exception_only"),
    ("exception_only", "no_trace"),
    ("ae_only", "vota"),
    ("loop_only", "vota"),
]
for child, parent in pairs:
    c = error_sets[child]
    p = error_sets[parent]
    is_subset = c.issubset(p)
    extra = c - p
    print(f"  {child} ⊆ {parent}: {is_subset} (|child|={len(c)}, |parent|={len(p)}, extra={len(extra)})")

# --- Pairwise Jaccard ---
print("\n=== Pairwise Jaccard Similarity ===")
names = list(CONDITIONS.keys())
n = len(names)
jaccard_matrix = np.zeros((n, n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        a, b = error_sets[names[i]], error_sets[names[j]]
        if len(a | b) == 0:
            jaccard_matrix[i, j] = 1.0
        else:
            jaccard_matrix[i, j] = len(a & b) / len(a | b)

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        print(f"  {names[i]} ∩ {names[j]}: J={jaccard_matrix[i,j]:.3f}, |∩|={len(error_sets[names[i]] & error_sets[names[j]])}")

# Build membership list

for s in error_sets.values():

    memberships.append(member_of)

print(f"\nSaved to {out_dir}/error_overlap.pdf and .png")

im = ax.imshow(jaccard_matrix, cmap='YlOrRd', vmin=0, vmax=1)
